description.narrative: TRAIDE Ethiopia Phase II is designed to strengthen the role of the private sector in solving development challenges in Ethiopia by turning promising ideas into viable, impact-driven business cases. Its goal is to identify opportunities where Dutch and Ethiopian businesses can jointly address local needs in sectors such as agriculture, water, and healthcare, and support these partnerships from early scoping to implementation and growth. In this way, TRAIDE helps unlock sustainable trade and investment, while making private sector engagement more practical, inclusive, and commercially viable in the Ethiopian context.The programme contributes directly to private sector development by helping businesses overcome barriers such as limited access to finance, weak market linkages, regulatory bottlenecks, and lack of trusted local partnerships. At the same time, it supports broader development outcomes by promoting job creation, entrepreneurship, skills development, stronger value chains, improved market access, and more responsible business practices. Through its focus on climate-relevant agriculture, water management, healthcare access, gender inclusion, and responsible business conduct, the programme also contributes to several Sustainable Development Goals, including decent work and economic growth, gender equality, clean water and sanitation, responsible consumption and production, climate action, and partnerships for the goals.In practice, TRAIDE will carry out a set of activities under its Assess–Build–Grow approach. It will identify and validate business opportunities through market analysis, stakeholder engagement, and feasibility assessment; support the co-creation of business concepts and partnerships between companies, public actors, and development partners; help structure these concepts into investable cases; and connect them to suitable sources of finance for pilots and scaling. Where relevant, TRAIDE will also support coordination during implementation, track lessons and impact, and work in a case-led way to address enabling-environment constraints that affect business success.
